iterationNotes: Earlier color runs identified an undersized native SwiftUI slider hit frame. A 44-point UISlider representable now passes the edge drag check in light and dark appearances.
Picker tests were updated for native navigation-link selection values and automatic return after choosing a different value.
The archive test lacked its expected public plan in the reused test simulator. Its fresh-simulator rerun with the standard synthetic seed passed.

Per-case results above are consolidated from successive runs; earlier mixed-result bundles are not claimed to have passed as a whole. Calendar checks preceded the final slider-only change; control and large-type checks cover the final implementation.
